test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Panthi folk dance belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chattisgarh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panthi**, one of the important dance forms in Chattisgarh is the folk dance of Chattisgarh.__
 
• It is mainly performed by the Satnami community of Chhattisgarh.
 
• Saila Dance, Karma, Sua Nacha, and Gendi are the other important folk dances of Chattisgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
